notes: Check explicit writing and operating-rules reviews. Preserve specialist deliverables and the author's supported meaning. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: What are the shared safety rules for this enablement skill pack around context files and external writes?
Before I run a specialist skill, remind me when I may edit .enablement/context.md and what I must not invent.
Set the package conventions for evidence, assumptions, and CRM write-back.
Give this enablement copy a light house-style edit. Keep the facts and any wording that already works.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Write spoken opener and close lines for a 12-minute discovery call.
Build a competitor battlecard with win zones and qualify-out conditions.
Create or refresh our reusable revenue enablement context file.
Review this one sales call and give me next-call coaching.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-house-style-rules
output_structure_checks.description: Reviews the requested writing or conventions, keeps useful wording, names actors and actions, and preserves material facts, uncertainty, and approval limits.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-house-style-not-deliverable
output_structure_checks.description: Returns revised copy for an edit or material findings for a review; does not assume installing a sibling skill causes these instructions to load.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-house-style-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: For clear, accurate input, retains most wording and returns only justified edits without a writing-process commentary.

task_scenarios.prompt: Lightly edit this internal enablement note. Keep any wording that works: Managers will review one discovery excerpt with each rep on Thursday. Choose a moment where the buyer describes a problem but its impact is unclear. Ask the rep to try a follow-up question, give feedback, and rehearse it again. Check the next eligible call for evidence that they used it.

assertions.name: enablement-house-style-preserve-clean-copy-1
assertions.description: Preserves the sequence, actors, existing Thursday commitment, and most wording; changes only a genuine clarity issue.

assertions.name: enablement-house-style-preserve-clean-copy-2
assertions.description: Does not add slogans, new requirements, a context questionnaire, invented benefits, or commentary about making the copy more human.
